source_title: Singer Shilpa Rao's show cut short, mic switched off at Mumbai event; fans react - India Today
source_excerpt:
Singer Shilpa Rao's performance at the Bollywood Music Project's 10th anniversary edition in Mumbai was cut short after organisers switched off her microphone mid-performance due to scheduling delays. It led to sparking outrage among fans online who slammed the management for disrespecting the artist.
Singer Shilpa Rao’s performance at the Bollywood Music Project in Mumbai was cut short on October 24, prompting the organisers to issue an apology. Her microphone and electronic audio equipment were reportedly switched off mid-performance as the event ran behind schedule. As Rao tried to thank the audience and bid farewell, fellow performer Kutle Khan began his set, interrupting her closing remarks.
Following the incident, Shilpa shared a statement on her Instagram story to express her disappointment while thanking the Mumbai audience for their support.
"Mumbai, a little piece of my heart broke tonight. It hurts deeply to have something so beautiful taken away from us like this," she wrote. "But even when the music stopped, you did not. The way you kept calling my name, the love in your voices... Our story tonight was left unfinished. I promise, I will come back (sic)."
The sudden interruption triggered strong backlash online, with festival-goers and fans slamming the organisers for mismanagement and disrespecting a senior artist. Outraged attendees highlighted that the event was running nearly 45 minutes late, resulting in shortened artist set times. Hashtags like "#JusticeForShilpaRao" quickly began trending across platforms.
Calling out the festival management, one attendee posted on X, "What happened with @shilparao11 at the #bollywoodmusicproject is just appalling she wasn't even given time to say thank you her music was cut mid way with electronics equipment all off (sic)."
Another fan commented, "Worst management... Shilpa was abruptly cut by Kutle Khan and the organisers shut the mic of shilpa mid-performance. Absolutely horrible production. I wish this never happens to any artist (sic)." Others echoed similar sentiments on Instagram, calling it "disrespectful behaviour" and criticising the event's time management.
In a social media statement, the organisers apologised for the abrupt end to Shilpa’s performance, saying they deeply regretted not being able to showcase her set in its entirety. They said they held the singer in high regard and considered it an honour to have her on the line-up.
Explaining the circumstances, they pointed to extended performances earlier in the event, which caused scheduling delays. They added that the festival had to follow local authority guidelines and venue curfew regulations, leaving them unable to accommodate the lost time.
The organisers also apologised to Shilpa, her team and her fans, acknowledging their disappointment and citing the operational challenges involved in running a large-scale live music festival. - Ends
